features.title: Grid typed JSONL loading
features.label: Typed JSONL loading
features.description: Local Python/Kajenn experiment: TYTX iterators retain typed values while building an isolated Bag. Only a complete stream replaces the selection; failed, cancelled or superseded loads retain the previous Bag. JSONL is not a general dataRpc transport contract.

features.title: Asqueel cachedFetch and bounded windows
features.label: cachedFetch windows
features.description: Local Asqueel-only experiment. Up to the configurable threshold (1,000 actual rows by default) selections are resident. Above it the database materializes the selection and the browser normally retains 200 rows. Unloaded row heights are estimated.

features.title: Asqueel server search and sort
features.label: Server search and sort
features.description: Search matches words across text columns on the server; it is not typed searchOn. Header clicks request server sorting, Shift adds criteria. Search and sort return to the beginning; obsolete responses cannot replace the current selection.

features.title: Asqueel selection snapshot lifecycle
features.label: Snapshot lifecycle
features.description: Reload refreshes the database snapshot; closing the page releases its cache. There is no live refresh or automatic TTL after a process crash. This experiment requires a dedicated cache-writable database configuration.
